lines.text: Many learners say: My brother he is a doctor.
Better: My brother is a doctor.
Is! My sister is a nurse.

data.wrong: My brother he is a doctor.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «أخي هو طبيب»، أما في الإنجليزية فلا نكرّر الفاعل بضمير: “My brother is a doctor.” وليس “My brother he is a doctor”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “My brother he is a doctor.” 😅 لا نكرّر الفاعل بضمير بعد ذكره، فالجملة الصحيحة “My brother is a doctor.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “is”. لا نكرّر الفاعل بضمير بعد ذكره. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “My brother he is a doctor”?
en.tip: We do not repeat the subject with a pronoun: “My brother is a doctor.” not “My brother he is a doctor”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “My brother he is a doctor.” 😅 In English we do not repeat the subject with a pronoun, so the right sentence is “My brother is a doctor.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
